FR-001.statement: Logistics operators and warehouse dispatchers should be able to log in securely using corporate multi-factor authentication.
FR-001.summary: Logistics operators and dispatchers should log in securely.

FR-002.statement: The system should enforce role-based access control restricting warehouse forklift drivers to assigned loading bays.
FR-002.summary: Role-based access control for forklift drivers to assigned bays.
FR-002.rationale: RBAC and physical facility zone permissions.

FR-003.statement: Supervisory credentials and manager override approval should be required before overriding dangerous cargo safety limits.
FR-003.summary: Manager override approval required for dangerous cargo safety limits.
FR-003.rationale: Supervisory override and security authority control.

FR-004.statement: System sessions should automatically expire after 15 minutes of terminal inactivity on ruggedized handheld scanners.
FR-004.summary: Session timeout after 15 minutes of scanner inactivity.

FR-005.statement: Freight carriers should be able to book loading dock appointments and reserve freight arrival time slots.
FR-005.summary: Carriers can book loading dock appointments and time slots.
FR-005.rationale: Dock appointment scheduling and slot reservation.

FR-006.statement: Warehouse supervisors should be able to schedule outbound freight delivery routes and allocate trucks to delivery windows.
FR-006.summary: Schedule delivery routes and allocate trucks to windows.
FR-006.rationale: Route delivery scheduling and resource slot reservation.

FR-007.statement: The system should prevent a loading bay marked unavailable for maintenance from accepting dock reservations.
FR-007.summary: Prevent unavailable loading bay from accepting dock reservations.
FR-007.rationale: Reservation constraint blocking bookings on unavailable bays.

FR-008.statement: Dock appointments should automatically expire if the transport vehicle fails to check in within 30 minutes of scheduled arrival.
FR-008.summary: Dock appointment expiration after 30 minutes late check-in.

FR-009.statement: The system should send automated SMS alerts to freight drivers when their designated loading dock is ready.
FR-009.summary: Send SMS alerts to drivers when loading dock is ready.

FR-010.statement: Warehouse managers should receive instant push notifications when a temperature-controlled cold-storage container experiences a temperature anomaly.
FR-010.summary: Push notifications for cold-storage temperature anomalies.

FR-011.statement: Automated email notifications should be dispatched to shippers when customs clearance paperwork is rejected.
FR-011.summary: Email notification to shippers upon customs paperwork rejection.

FR-012.statement: The system should dispatch alert notifications to terminal staff when dangerous goods dwell time exceeds permissible safety limits.
FR-012.summary: Alert terminal staff when dangerous goods dwell time exceeds limit.

FR-013.statement: The system should maintain persistent inventory records of pallet barcode, SKU, aisle location, bin number, weight, and expiry date.
FR-013.summary: Maintain persistent inventory records of pallet, SKU, and aisle location.
FR-013.rationale: Core warehouse inventory master record storage.

FR-014.statement: Immutable database audit logs should preserve every pallet movement and bin transfer for at least 7 years for regulatory compliance.
FR-014.summary: Preserve pallet transfer audit logs for 7 years.

FR-015.statement: The system should record forklift equipment telematics, battery charging cycles, and inspection history in the central database.
FR-015.summary: Record forklift telematics and inspection history in database.

FR-016.statement: Database backup and disaster recovery replication should ensure zero data loss for freight manifests across secondary storage clusters.
FR-016.summary: Database backup and replication for freight manifests.
FR-016.rationale: Data store backup and persistence durability.

FR-017.statement: Operations executives should be able to generate quarterly freight throughput reports and warehouse capacity utilization analytics.
FR-017.summary: Generate freight throughput reports and utilization analytics.
FR-017.rationale: Analytical report generation and business utilization metrics.

FR-018.statement: The system should calculate average dock turnaround times and carrier on-time delivery statistical distributions.
FR-018.summary: Calculate dock turnaround times and on-time delivery statistics.
FR-018.rationale: Operational KPI metrics and performance analytics.

FR-019.statement: Logistics managers should be able to export carbon emission summaries and fleet fuel consumption reports.
FR-019.summary: Export carbon emission summaries and fuel consumption reports.
FR-019.rationale: Executive summary report export and emission analytics.

FR-020.statement: The system should generate carrier demurrage charge analytics and freight invoice penalty reconciliation summaries.
FR-020.summary: Generate carrier demurrage analytics and penalty reconciliation summaries.
FR-020.rationale: Financial performance reporting and demurrage analytics.
